notes: This contract records Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped directed-interaction slice: one non-regional directed target, constrained and nonconstrained recipients captured in a federation-owned recipient ledger, TSO queueing before Time Advance Grant for the constrained recipient, callback-gated delivery, official timestamp/order/retraction callback fields, lower-bound validation, pending-fanout suppression, a legal post-delivery Request Retraction callback for the delivered nonconstrained recipient, and a narrow save/restore regression that prevents a discarded post-save retraction designator from aliasing a fresh post-restore directed message. The shared recipient planner honors the by-ownership versus universal selector, while this timestamped contract's existing cases do not independently distinguish those modes. It does not claim directed DDM, alternate advance modes, complete save/restore semantics, remote transport, catalog evidence, or conformance.
